notes:
Lead sourced from docs search demo page. SMB, building a verticalized doc-search product for marketplace sellers. Interested in hosted_api for fast time-to-value; low ops team.

Key quotes: "Need embeddings cost to be predictable — we do nightly reindexing of ~200k docs." 

What they care about: latency for RAG (sub-300ms tail for short queries), cost per monthly embed run, easy connector to Weaviate (their current eval), simple auth (SAML for admin), and audit logs for compliance.

SE impressions: team is small but technical (full-stack + 1 ML engineer). They prefer code samples over deep sales decks. Asking for concrete sample of: chunking strategy, embed batch sizing, re-ranking pipeline using hosted generate endpoint with embeddings -> dense retrieval -> rerank.

Conversation fragments / shorthand:
- "POC: nightly ingest + on-search rerank"
- "Target qps: 5-10 sustained, burst to 50"
- "Latency SLO: 200-300ms p95 for short queries; rerank can be async for long contexts"
- "Model preference: open models ok (Llama2 variants) but want fallback to faster / quantized model if cost spikes"

Security notes: SAML for admin console, KMS for key material, audit log retention 1yr requested. No air-gapped requirement, public cloud ok (AWS).

Docs/links to send: quickstart for embeddings, weaviate connector example, pricing scenarios for nightly reindex, sample canary rollout config for model fallback.

use_case_summary: SMB doc-search vendor building a RAG product for e-commerce merchants. Primary flow: ingest product docs, create embeddings nightly (~200k docs), run dense retrieval + lightweight reranking on user queries. Needs hosted API for indexing + re-ranking to avoid ops burden. Key questions: embedding unit costs, batch sizing, Weaviate connector examples, p95 latency targets, and auth/audit controls for admin console.
requirements_detail: Docs volume: ~200k documents initially; growing 10-20% m/m
Query profile: 5-10 qps typical, 50 qps bursts during campaigns
Latency: p95 target 200-300ms for top-k retrieval + rerank (aim to keep rerank under 100ms for top-5)
Cost sensitivity: tight - prefer recommendations for quantized models or hybrid routing
Model routing: want policy to route low-cost traffic to smaller model and fall back to higher-quality model on ambiguity
Vector DB: primary eval is Weaviate; also looking at Pinecone as backup
